`npm run ci` passes now. Both the unit test and the two Playwright tests are green.

**What was wrong:** the e2e test `e2e/security.spec.js` ("sign in and out") requires the session cookies to be HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite Lax or Strict. The `sid` session cookie was set without `httpOnly`, so scripts in the page could read it. The other cookies it checks already had the flag.

**What I changed:** in `app.js`, the `res.cookie('sid', ...)` call at line 106 now includes `httpOnly: true`. I left the test alone because it is enforcing a real security policy.

I didn't check whether anything in the front end depended on reading `sid` from JavaScript. The only cookie `public/app.js` reads is `csrf_token`, which I didn't touch. I haven't committed anything.
